checkpoint_policy: every completed engine chunk and graceful exit; an interrupted chunk may be replayed from its saved start

rng.initial_seed_derivation: base_seed + global_worker_ordinal * 1000003; per-engine seed offset engine_index * 104729

sharing_policy: same target ID and exact matrix hash only; recipient objective improvement within depth/gate limits; engine states reset on adoption
symmetry: none; no rotations or input permutations are applied

source_provenance.matrix_metadata_note: Original circuit vecRows/vecCols comments are transposed relative to its official .mat file. Replayed outputs match .mat rows; .mat bytes define this target.

original_metadata.rng_evidence: Chunk-start state is saved beside this record; callback-time RNG state is not exposed; endpoint states are saved when available
original_metadata.verification_scope: exact linear target matrix; affine output complements are excluded from XOR search
